title: A brain circuit linking sleep loss to pain
title_zh: 睡眠剥夺与疼痛敏感性相关的大脑回路
abstract: Sleep loss heightens pain sensitivity, but the brain circuits involved remain unclear. In a recent study, Huang, Wang, Jiao, and colleagues identified a pathway connecting the retrosplenial cortex, anterior cingulate cortex, and zona incerta that contributes to heightened sensitivity to mechanical stimulation and heat after sleep deprivation in male mice.
abstract_zh: 睡眠剥夺会增强疼痛敏感性，但涉及的脑回路尚不清楚。最近的一项研究中，黄、王、焦等人发现了一条连接后顶叶皮层、前扣带皮层和不确定区的通路，该通路在雄性小鼠睡眠剥夺后导致对机械刺激和热刺激的敏感性升高。
